_comment: Context for translators. Keys must match en.json. Tone: plain, short, no ERP jargon (design system README, Content).
appTeacher: App name shown under the logo and on the home screen. Keep the brand name OruSchools in Latin letters.
appStaff: App name for non-teaching staff (office, lab assistants, support).
appParent: App name for parents and students.
appPlatform: Name of the platform administration site (for the SaaS owner).
appWebsite: Title of the public website (browser tab). The tagline 'Schools. People. Progress.' is fixed brand copy: translate it only with approval (brand guidelines).
scaffoldNotice: Temporary placeholder text on unfinished screens. Not shown to schools in production.
greetingMorning: Home screen greeting before 12:00. {name} is the person's first name.
greetingAfternoon: Home screen greeting 12:00-17:00. {name} is the person's first name.
greetingEvening: Home screen greeting after 17:00. {name} is the person's first name.
actionUploadNow: Button that sends saved offline work immediately.
actionTakeAttendance: Primary button on the teacher home screen.
actionMarkAllPresent: Button that marks every student present; the teacher then changes only the exceptions.
actionSubmitAttendance: Primary button that submits the class attendance.
syncSynced: Sync status: all work is on the server.
syncSavedOnDevice: Sync status: work is saved on this phone and will upload when online.
syncChangesPending: Sync status: number of changes waiting to upload. Use the language's correct plural forms.
syncFailed: Sync status: the upload did not work.
statusLate: Attendance status: arrived after the bell.
statusMedical: Attendance status: absent for a medical reason.
statusHalfDay: Attendance status: present for half the day.
errorServerUnreachable: Error message. Reassures the user that nothing is lost; never blames them.
saasSignInTitle: Heading of the platform owner's sign-in screen.
saasSignInIntro: One line under the sign-in heading. Schools sign in elsewhere.
authEmailLabel: Label of the email field on sign-in.
authPasswordLabel: Label of the password field on sign-in.
actionSignIn: Button that signs a person in.
actionSignInGoogle: Button for Google sign-in. Keep the word Google in Latin letters.
actionSignInPhone: Link that switches sign-in to a one-time code sent by SMS.
actionSignInEmail: Link that switches sign-in back to email and password.
authPhoneLabel: Label of the phone number field.
authPhoneHint: Hint under the phone field. Keep the example number as it is.
actionSendCode: Button that sends a one-time code by SMS.
authCodeLabel: Label of the field where the SMS code is typed.
actionVerifyCode: Button that checks the SMS code.
authOr: Small word between two sign-in options.
actionSignOut: Button that signs the person out.
authSigningIn: Shown on the button while sign-in is in progress.
authErrorCredentials: Error after a wrong email or password. Do not say which one is wrong.
authErrorTooMany: Error when sign-in is temporarily blocked.
authErrorNetwork: Error when the device is offline during sign-in.
authErrorPopupClosed: Error when the person closes the Google sign-in window.
authErrorCode: Error after a wrong or expired SMS code.
authErrorPhone: Error for a phone number that is not valid.
saasNoAccessTitle: Heading shown to a signed-in person who is not the platform owner.
saasNoAccessBody: Explains the previous heading and what to do.
saasNavLabel: Screen reader name of the side navigation.
saasNavSchools: Side navigation item for the list of schools.
saasSchoolsCount: Number of schools under the heading.
saasSchoolsEmptyTitle: Empty state heading on the schools screen.
actionCreateSchool: Button that opens the create school form and submits it.
saasSchoolCreateTitle: Heading of the create school form.
saasSchoolName: Label of the school name field.
saasSchoolSubdomain: Label of the school's web address field (its subdomain).
saasSchoolSubdomainHint: Hint under the web address field. Keep the example as it is.
saasSchoolLanguage: Label of the school's default language choice.
actionEdit: Button that opens a form to change something.
saasSchoolEditTitle: Heading of the edit school form.
actionReactivate: Button that reactivates a suspended school.
saasSuspendTitle: Heading of the suspend confirmation. {name} is the school name.
saasSuspendReason: Label of the optional reason for suspending.
statusActive: Status of a school that is running.
statusSuspended: Status of a school that is suspended.
saasLoadFailed: Heading of the error when the list fails to load.
actionLoadMore: Button that loads the next page of a list.
errorAuthRequired: Error when the session has ended.
errorForbidden: Error when the action is not allowed.
errorNotFound: Error when something no longer exists.
errorInvalidRequest: Error when the server rejects the form.
errorConflict: Error when a name or web address is already taken.
errorRateLimited: Error when the person is sending requests too fast.
errorUpstream: Error when a back-end service is unavailable.
errorNetwork: Error when the device is offline.
errorTimeout: Error when a request times out.
statusLoading: Shown while a screen or list is loading.
actionAddAdmin: Button that adds the first administrator of a school.
saasAdminTitle: Heading of the form that adds a school's first administrator. {name} is the school name.
saasAdminIntro: Explains the add administrator form: the person sets their own password, and only the first administrator is added by the platform owner.
saasAdminName: Label of the administrator's name field.
saasAdminAdded: Confirmation after adding an administrator who signs in with email. {email} is their address.
saasAdminAddedNoEmail: Confirmation after adding an administrator who signs in by phone code only.
saasAdminEmailFailed: Warning when the account was created but the password email failed. Keep the quoted button name the same as the 'Forgot password?' text.
saasAdminExists: Error when the platform owner tries to add a second first-administrator.
errorAccountExists: Error when an email or phone number already has an account.
authForgot: Link on sign-in that sends an email to set a new password.
authResetSent: Shown after asking for a password email. Does not reveal whether the address has an account.
authResetNeedsEmail: Shown when 'Forgot password?' is pressed with the email field empty.
saasHasAdmin: Badge on a school that already has an administrator.
saasNoAdmin: Badge on a school that has no administrator yet, so nobody can sign in to it.
webSignInTitle: Heading of a school's sign-in screen. {name} is the school's name.
webSignInIntro: One line under the school sign-in heading.
webSchoolNotFoundTitle: Heading when the web address does not belong to an active school.
webNoSchoolTitle: Heading when the app is opened without a school's own web address.
webNoSchoolBody: Explains that people reach the app at their school's own address. Keep the example as it is.
webNoAccessTitle: Heading shown to a signed-in person who is not a member of this school. {name} is the school's name.
webNoAccessBody: Explains what to do about no access.
webLoadFailed: Heading of the error when the person's account details fail to load after sign-in.
webNavLabel: Screen reader name of the school's side navigation.
webComingTitle: Heading shown for a navigation item whose screen is not built yet.
webYourRole: Line on the dashboard that names the person's role in the school. {role} is the role name.
errorPageTitle: Heading of the page-level error screen.
actionTryAgain: Button that retries after an error.
